description: This Python script manages user data for Open5GS, including adding users, reading subscriber data from CSV or string, and interacting with a MongoDB database via the Open5GS client. It includes command-line options for database connection and subscriber data input.

methods.name: add_user
methods.description: Constructs user data dictionary for Open5GS MongoDB insertion, including session and security info.

methods.name: read_from_db
methods.description: Reads subscriber data from a CSV file and returns a list of subscriber dictionaries.

methods.name: read_from_string
methods.description: Parses a subscriber data string into a subscriber dictionary.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main command-line interface function that reads subscriber data and adds or updates users in Open5GS via MongoDB.
